items.title: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT booms in IPO. Does US memory stand a chance?
items.summary: China's biggest memory chipmaker, ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), is surging in its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what investors should know about emerging Chinese competition in the tech space.

items.title: Apple's Pre-Earnings Rally Pushes Stock Near Record Highs
items.summary: Apple stock is nearing fresh records ahead of its earnings release.  The company is set to report earnings after the bell on Thursday in what will be Tim Cook's last earnings call as CEO.  It will also be the first quarterly release since the company raised prices to offset higher memory costs.

items.title: Apple Could Reclaim Market-Cap Crown Today
items.summary: Apple is on pace to snap Nvidia's 272-trading-day streak as the largest U.S. company by market cap.  The iPhone maker, which has never cracked the $5 trillion market cap threshold, is also closing in on that milestone.  Apple's stock price today hit a new all-time intraday high of $339.50.

items.title: Why Are Chip Stocks Down? Investors’ Three Big Worries
items.summary: U.S. chip stocks are taking a beating Monday after a stratospheric stock market debut by Chinese memory-chip maker CXMT. But that's only the latest development to rattle jittery investors. Also:   Apple has been lobbying the Trump administration on a plan to use memory chips from China in some Apple products.
